Instructor Payout Report

How to access your Payout Report

You can view this information on the Payout Report page.

To access the page from the instructor view, click on your profile image in the top-right corner. From the dropdown, select Payout report.

How to view the Payout Report

On the main Payout Report page, you can view your current amount to be paid and check the status of all previous payouts. Additionally, you’ll receive important notifications, including missing payout or alerts relevant to your tax information.

Amount To Be Paid

Under Amount To Be Paid, you can view your existing balance available for withdrawal for your next payout.

  • Learn more about Udemy’s payment process and schedule for instructors. Important note: Due to transaction fees, the amount payable to the instructor must be a minimum of $25 USD in order for the payment to be issued. Once the cumulative amount payable reaches $25 USD the payment will be issued. All remaining balances under $25 USD will be issued to instructors in December.

Payout History

The Payout History section allows you to monitor the status of all your instructor payouts over time. Here, you can:

  • Review the history and payout method for each monthly payout.
  • Track the amount of each payment, including tax withholdings.
  • Check the month each payout was initiated.
  • Keep track of the current status of your payouts Payout statuses

Each payout item has one of the following statuses to help you keep track of what has been paid out

  • Success: The payout has been successfully sent to your instructor payment method.
    • Note: The payment may take additional time to appear in your account, depending on your banking provider’s processing time.
  • Failed: The payout was attempted by Udemy but was not delivered. See the troubleshooting steps below for actions you can take to resolve this.
  • Processing: The payout is currently being processed. You should see a status update within 3 business days.
  • Queuing: The payout is currently in the queue. We will attempt to process it within 10 business days.
  • Ready to Pay: The payout is ready to be processed in the queue. We will attempt to process it within 5 business days.
  • Initial: This status may appear before your payout is ready to begin processing. For most payment methods, you should see a status update within 5 business days.
  • Blocked: The payout is currently being blocked. Please follow the troubleshooting steps below to unblock your payment.
  • Unpaid: The payout has been canceled or resent with a new payout.
  • Undefined: The status of your payout is currently not defined in our system, which can occur with certain payout methods. We are continuing to process your payment, and you can expect to see an update in the payout status.

Troubleshooting failed instructor payouts

Instructors will automatically receive email notifications regarding the status of their payouts, and whether they have been successfully processed or have encountered an issue.

If you encounter an unsuccessful payout status, or if your Payout Report is showing that you should have received a payout but haven’t, please check the following:

  • On your Payout Settings page, check to see that you have set up a payment method (PayPal, Payoneer, Tipalti, or direct deposit (U.S. only)).
  • If you have set up PayPal or Payoneer as your payment method, check to see if your PayPal or Payoneer account is verified to receive payments.
  • If you are using Tipalti, review answers to frequently asked questions about Tipalti.
  • Depending on the payment method you have selected, contact PayPal, Payoneer, Tipalti, or your bank to see if there are any issues with your account. If you’re still having trouble, please contact Udemy Support by clicking Contact Us. Please be sure to mention which monthly payments you have not received.

Instructor Revenue Report

Once a student has purchased your course, you’ll have access to the instructor revenue report, where you can track and review your course sales. In addition to an overview of your course sales, the Revenue Report includes transactional details for each enrollment, revenue by channel, and data regarding your own promotional activity.

How to view the Revenue Report

The revenue report can be reached from every page on Udemy. To access your revenue report, please follow the steps below:

  • From the instructor view, move your cursor to your profile image in the top-right-hand of the page
  • Click on Revenue report from the dropdown menu

Lifetime earnings and revenue channels

On the main, revenue report page, you can see your Lifetime Earnings (pre-tax) and sales data based on specific revenue channels. For example, if you’ve been running your own promotions and distributing instructor coupon codes, you’ll be able to review how that revenue channel has been performing.

Lifetime earnings are determined by utilizing the formula below:

TOTAL EARNINGS = YOUR SHARE OF TOTAL PURCHASES + OTHER REVENUE - REFUNDS

To review your earnings through specific revenue channels, however, please do the following:

  • Hover over the chart to see how each channel is performing.
  • Click and drag to zoom in for a closer look at the graph. The revenue channels include: Udemy Business, Udemy Organic, Your Promotions, Ad Program, Affiliate Program, Personal Plan, Adjustment, Refunds, Subscriber Signup Payment, and External Partners. To review more information regarding each of these channels, simply click on the icon to the right of the channel’s title.

When Udemy-driven sales are assigned to attribution channels

To help ensure accurate revenue reporting, attribution channels for Udemy-driven sales are not assigned until 72 hours after the transaction. While these sales will appear promptly in your sales list and your total earnings, they won’t appear on visualizations that split out revenue by channel attribution, until they have a final attribution.

Monthly summary

In addition to your overall data, sales are categorized by month on your Revenue Report. Scroll down the revenue report to see the expected payment dates, the pre-tax amount, withheld tax totals, and your net earnings for a specific month. To see a more detailed sales report for a specific month, simply click on the month in the Time Period column.

  • For more detailed information on instructor payments, learn more about the instructor Payout Report. On your monthly summary page, you can review the following pie charts:

Total earnings

After clicking on a specific month, you can see a breakdown of your course revenue (pre-tax earnings) and refunds in the first pie chart. To review an individual course’s performance by sales channel, simply select the applicable course in the course filter.

Your promotion activity

The second pie chart shows which of your promotions are driving sales. Udemy coupons will not appear in this section, only instructor coupons that you’ve created for your courses.

Your earnings by course

The third pie chart on the right-hand side of the page, breaks down your sales, by course.

The following pages are also available for each monthly report:

Other: other revenue includes external partner payments and adjustments (corrections for any errors in past statements).

Personal Plan: this category includes details regarding revenue your courses may have earned from the Personal Plan subscription. Note: this page will only be visible after revenue has been received and added from the Personal Plan channel. Learn more about payments for Personal Plan.

Purchases: Your share of total purchases is your net revenue after revenues are split with Udemy, any marketing partners (e.g., affiliates), and any co-instructors on your course. Learn more about how Udemy’s revenue sharing plan works.

Redemptions: Redemptions occur when a coupon or gift code is redeemed to purchase a course. This can include Enrollments that take place via third party sites, like Groupon for example, which also require coupon code redemptions.

Refunds: details regarding refunds for your courses, and the change to your revenue is posted on this page.

Udemy Business: this category includes details regarding revenue your courses may have earned from the Udemy Business Content Subscription program. Note: this page will only be visible if revenue has been received and added from the Udemy Business channel.

Viewing single transaction details

You can also review detailed information for each transaction, including the time of the enrollment, the platform it took place on, and any fees or taxes that were applied. To see additional information for a transaction, click on View Details that’s posted in Your Revenue column on the right-hand side.

Learn more about how instructor revenue is calculated.

Exporting the Revenue Report as a .csv

You can download the revenue report as a .csv file in order to further analyze the data. After clicking into a monthly statement, click Export as CSV at the bottom of the page, enter your email, and we’ll send you the file within a few minutes.

Why is a user name on my Revenue Report but not on the Student List?

When a student receives your course as a Udemy gift, their username will be added to your student list, after they redeem the gift code and enroll in your course. The username of the gift purchaser, however, is listed in the purchase tab of your revenue report, and is not included on the student list (unless they purchased the course for themselves previously).

Instructor revenue share

This article outlines Udemy’s revenue sharing plan for premium instructors. Udemy seeks to create a sustainable partnership with instructors, where instructors are rewarded for creating amazing content and bringing students to the platform, and Udemy is rewarded for driving sales for our instructors.

There is no fee to create and host a course on Udemy, and you can publish as many free and paid courses as you like.

While we encourage you to take a look at the Instructor Terms for additional information regarding Udemy’s revenue share, a summary of the sharing plan for transactional sales is below.

Please note these are revenue shares on the Net Amount, which is the amount a student paid less any applicable taxes or fees, such as the 30% fee imposed by Apple or Google for sales on iOS and Android. A full definition of the Net Amount is available in our Instructor Terms.

Table of contents

  • Instructor course content revenue share
  • Connect 1:1 revenue share
  • Reporting

Instructor course content revenue share

The revenue share for instructor course content is as follows.

Please note: Revenue share for coaching services is separately addressed below.

  • Sales occurring through instructor promotions: instructors receive 97% of the revenue when the student purchases their content using an instructor’s coupon or referral link.
  • Sales that do not occur through an instructor promotion: instructors receive 37% of the revenue for any Udemy sales where no instructor coupon or course referral link was used. These sales might occur after a user clicks on a Udemy advertisement, or browses the Udemy marketplace for courses. Instructors may also participate in our Udemy Business program. Learn how to earn revenue from Udemy Business and Personal Plan.

Please note:

  • The summary above outlines the revenue share between Udemy and instructors for a given sale It does not factor in any additional revenue sharing that an instructor may have allocated for co-instructors.

Instructor subscription revenue

Instructors can also participate and earn revenue in our Udemy Business and Subscription Plan programs.

Connect 1-1 revenue share

For Connect: 1-1, where Udemy sells a session at a promotional price below your selected Base Price, Udemy will calculate your Gross Amount using your selected Base Price.

However, we will not use this alternate method if the sale price is lower than your Base Price due to adjustments otherwise permitted by the Instructor Terms, such as those for mobile platform pricing and currency conversions.

For Connect 1-1, instructors receive 80% of the Net Amount from completed booked sessions, while Udemy receives 20% of the Net Amount.

Please note: As mentioned above, the learner payment is first adjusted for applicable taxes and processing fees.

Learn how to set up and manage Connect 1-1.

Reporting

Instructors can track all incoming sales in their Revenue Report. Some of the information the report includes are the student name, the date of purchase, and the total price paid. Learn more about the instructor revenue report.

Instructors: Payoneer FAQ

Udemy has partnered with Payoneer, a leading global payments service provider, to offer our instructors another flexible, low-cost payment method. Payments from Payoneer can be delivered to your local bank account or to your prepaid Mastercard® card.

Below are some of the frequently asked questions and answers regarding Payoneer.

How do I register with Payoneer?

From the Udemy Premium Instructor payout selection page, choose Payoneer as your payment method. Continue the signup process as prompted.

Learn how to become a premium instructor and set up your payment method.

Payoneer prepaid MasterCard® sign up:

Click “Connect” and select the prepaid MasterCard® option from the index page. Follow the registration process and complete the registration steps.

The Prepaid Debit MasterCard® will be mailed to you in over 200 countries and credited with your payments from Udemy. After receiving the card, you will be able to use it just like a regular debit card.

For more information regarding the prepaid card and what countries it’s available in, please contact Payoneer Support.

Local Bank Transfer sign up:

Click “Connect” and choose the Bank Transfers option from the index page. Follow the registration process and complete the registration steps. Make sure that you have your local bank account details handy as you’ll need them during the sign up.

Local Bank transfer lets you quickly, easily and safely receive money directly to your bank account in local currency, after initiating the withdrawal in your Payoneer account. Revenue is transferred directly to your local bank account in your local currency. Funds are available within 1–3 business days.

What happens after I register?

Once you have submitted your Payoneer application, you can view your account status at any time by logging into your Payoneer account - My Account.

New applications can take several business days to be approved (usually no more than 3 business days). Once approved, you will receive an email confirmation with further details. In some situations, you may be asked to provide extra details such as a copy of your ID, Certificate of Incorporation, bank statement or other documents.

What if I’m already a Payoneer user?

If you’re already a Payoneer user, select “Already have a Payoneer Account” during registration.

How long does it take for the payment from Payoneer to be transferred to my account?

Udemy payments are delivered to instructors monthly, after the 30 day period for refunds has ended. Learn more about Udemy’s payment schedule for instructors.

Once Udemy transfers the revenue you’ve earned to your Payoneer account and you request a withdrawal, the processing time for transferring to your bank account may vary, depending on your country and payment method: The estimated time for local transfers from Payoneer to your bank account is 1-3 business days. The estimated time for transfers from Payoneer to your card is within 2 hours.

What fees are included when receiving funds?

The exact fees depend on the card or Local Bank Transfer. Detailed pricing and fees information can be viewed during registration on the top left corner under the “Fees” tab. After registration, please go to the “Pricing & Fees” tab located under the “Help” menu in My Account. For pricing and fees for Local Bank Transfers, you will have an opportunity to see and approve this in Step 4 during the registration process before submitting the application.

Is there a minimum amount required for withdrawals?

For information regarding minimum withdrawal amounts that may apply to your Payoneer account, please contact Payoneer Support.

How can I receive more information?

For more information in English and other languages, please contact Payoneer Support.

What benefits does Tipalti offer?

Tipalti offers a lower FX fee, making it a more cost-effective choice for international transactions. In addition, Tipalti provides the convenience of direct bank transfers, ensuring funds are deposited straight into your bank account.

More information regarding Tipalti is available in their support center.

How do I register or switch to using Tipalti?

Learn how eligible premium instructors can set up Tipalti.

Which payment method should I select?

The best payment method depends on your specific circumstances.

Payment processing costs can vary depending on currencies, banks, and individual circumstances. We recommend checking the fees applicable to your situation and confirming with your bank about any receiving fees.

  • See how to check applicable fees during set up. Udemy supports these Tipalti payment methods:
Wire transfer

Wire transfer enables you to receive payouts in the currency of your choice. This method provides you with more flexibility in how you receive your earnings.

Direct deposit/ACH transfer

ACH is a method of local bank transfer, enabling you to receive payouts directly into your bank account. With ACH, the funds are usually delivered in your local currency.

What fees does Tipalti charge?

Transactions and FX fees differ depending on individual factors, such as locale and currency.

During the Tipalti setup process, follow the prompts on screen and complete all required fields, such as country, bank name, and IBAN. Your transaction fee will then be shown to you.

See how to check applicable fees during set up.

Which currencies is Tipalti available in?

Tipalti is available to instructors in many countries worldwide. See Tipalti’s support documentation for detailed information on each of the available currencies.

Which countries is Tipalti available in?

Tipalti is available in many countries around the world. For a list of available countries and the Global ACH and Wire transfer information, please review this article.

Do I need to be linked to my own bank account?

Yes. Instructors must use a bank account in their name for Tipalti payouts.

Will my tax information change if I use Tipalti?

If you’re switching to Tipalti for your payouts, your tax information may need to be re-verified.

Tipalti will notify you if any additional tax forms are required. For full details on tax reporting, VAT/GST compliance, and required documentation, please contact Tipalti support.

Why is my payout missing or delayed?

Payouts processed through Tipalti generally follow the timelines outlined in the Payout Report page.

If you are having trouble receiving your instructor payout, please follow the troubleshooting steps below.

  • Check Payout Status: In your Payout Report report, check that your payout status is set to Success. Otherwise, please review the troubleshooting steps for instructor payments.
  • Verify bank details: Confirm your bank information in Tipalti is correct and is in your name. Errors in bank details can lead to payout delays or failures.
  • Contact Tipalti Support: Please contact Tipalti support if the above steps don’t resolve your issue. As Udemy Support doesn’t have access to Tipalti’s system, our team is unable to resolve these types of issues.

Who can I contact for assistance?

For further assistance or questions not listed above, please reach out to the appropriate support team.

Tipalti Support

For questions regarding transaction failures, entering your bank details, and applicable tax information, please contact Tipalti Support directly.

Note: Since Udemy Support doesn’t have to access Tipalti’s system, our team is unable to resolve these types of issues.

Udemy Support

For questions regarding instructor payout methods or payment policies please contact Udemy Support.

Instructor Verification

Instructor identity verification process

To maintain the integrity of our learning community, all instructors must verify their identity before they can publish a course on the marketplace.

When instructors are required to verify their identity

If you have not yet verified your identity with Udemy, you will be prompted to complete instructor verification when you’re ready to submit a new course for review.

When your first course has been uploaded and is ready to be published, the Udemy site will guide you through the automated verification process.

Instructors may also be directed to complete the verification process after publishing a course, as Udemy’s Trust & Safety Team runs periodic sweeps of more established instructors. The two-step process should only take a few minutes. You can exit and re-enter the flow at any time, but be sure to complete by any specified deadline.

Information instructors may need to provide during the verification process

During the verification process, instructors will see some or all of the following prompts:

  • Request to confirm ownership rights to the course content
  • Request to provide information regarding their current place of residence
  • Request to provide identity documents such as a national ID or passport Please note: the information required will vary depending on the instructor’s country of residence and/or activity patterns within the account.

This information is strictly confidential, and is reviewed by a third party identity verification service provider in order to validate details.

Completing the verification process

Successful submission and verification with the automated system should only take seconds. Please review your information carefully before submitting as you will only have limited attempts to successfully verify your information.

After the automated verification process has been completed our team will review your submission and confirm with you, via email, that your account has been verified and that you can submit your course for review.

The email that is sent confirming your account has been verified, will be sent to the email address that is registered with your Udemy account. Generally, the confirmation process takes 2 -3 business days.

If you are having trouble completing the verification for your account, please reach out to policy@udemy.com with any questions you may have.

Instructor identity verification process: Frequently asked questions

To maintain the integrity of our learning community, all instructors must verify their identity before they can publish a course on the marketplace. This article answers frequently asked questions regarding the instructor identity verification process.

  • Learn more about the automated instructor identity verification process.

Frequently asked questions

  • Do I need to complete verification every time I submit a new course for review?
  • How does Udemy verify my personal data?
  • How is my information handled?
  • What happens if I do not pass the automated identity verification by the deadline?
  • Will I need to still submit my course for review after I complete identity verification?
  • If I am a co-instructor in a course, do I need to complete identity verification?
  • If I am an instructor on Udemy Business, do I need to complete identity verification?
  • Is verification required for free courses?
  • Can I use a pen name or pseudonym for my instructor account?
  • Can I use my business name for the verification process?
  • Can I use a profile picture that is not my own?
  • Can I be verified as an instructor if I am under the age of 18?

Do I need to complete verification every time I submit a new course for review?

Identity verification is typically only required once per account. Some instructors may be prompted to complete the process again if there are flags identified in account activity or course content.

How does Udemy verify my personal data?

Udemy partners with third-party vendors, which utilize trusted and licensed data sources including; credit bureaus, electoral rolls, government-issued public and private data, telephone/utility records, and watch lists to verify the information you provide.

How is my information handled?

Please see Udemy’s Privacy Policy for details on all types of account data.

What happens if I do not pass the automated identity verification by the deadline?

All instructors must be verified when publishing courses on Udemy. If the process is not completed by the deadline specified, any associated courses and accounts will be frozen. If you have any difficulty, please contact policy@udemy.com with any questions.

Will I need to submit my course for review after I complete identity verification?

Yes, once you have successfully completed verification, please submit your course for review through the course management dashboard.

If I am a co-instructor in a course, do I need to complete identity verification?

No. Only the course owner must complete verification before the course can be submitted for review.

If I am an instructor on Udemy Business, do I need to complete identity verification?

No, this is only required for instructors on the marketplace.

Is verification required for free courses?

Yes. All published instructors are required to complete the verification process. This helps ensure the integrity of the marketplace.

Can I use a pen name or pseudonym for my instructor account?

While you can create an account under a pen name or pseudonym, you may be asked to complete additional verification if it differs from your legal name.

Please note: With the exception of your instructor account name, all other information that is included in your profile must be accurate to complete the verification process.

  • Learn how to update your profile information

Can I use my business name for the verification process?

If a business name is submitted, we may need to speak to a representative of the company and verify that you are associated with that business. As a result, the verification process could take longer.

Can I use a profile picture that is not my own?

Using a profile picture of another person, even if from a stock image or an image that is AI-generated, is not permitted.

Can I be verified as an instructor if I am under the age of 18?

According to our Terms of Use, you must be 18 years old to create an account on Udemy.

If you are above the required age for consent to use online services where you live, you can publish a paid course through a legal guardian’s account, following their consent during the verification process. If we discover that you have created an account that violates these rules, we will terminate your account.

Downloading Courses for Offline Viewing on The iOS App

This article explains how to download entire courses, course sections, or course lectures for offline viewing in the Udemy iOS app. We also provide instructions on how to update your course download settings to reduce mobile data usage.

  • Learn how to remove downloaded courses on the Udemy mobile app.
  • Accessing Udemy on a different device? Learn how to download courses on a browser or how to download courses on the Android app. Please note: Due to privacy concerns, downloaded courses are encrypted and can only be accessed through the mobile app. Not all courses and course resources, including practice tests, are available for download.

Downloading entire courses for offline viewing

  1. After signing into the Udemy mobile app, tap My learning.

  2. Tap on the course you wish to take.

  3. Tap on the download icon on the right side of Lectures.

  4. Tap Download Course.

Downloading course sections or course lectures

You can also download all of the courses in particular sections or individual course lectures on the iOS mobile app.

To download a course section, tap the download icon on the right of the section header. Then, tap Download Section.

To download a course lecture, tap the download icon on the right of the lecture name.

Viewing downloaded courses offline

To view all course downloads, tap on the Downloads section under the course title.

Regaining access to downloaded content

Please note: Due to certain platform security measures, some downloaded course content will expire after 30 days. To regain access to the downloaded content, simply connect your mobile device to the internet.

Update your course download data settings

  1. After signing in to the Udemy mobile app, tap Account.

  2. Under Video Preferences, tap Download Options.

To reduce your course data storage, tap on Video download quality and select your quality preference.

To avoid data usage, tap Download over Wi-Fi only. If you play downloaded lectures while your mobile data is still turned on, the Udemy app will not use mobile data to load the video content.

Please note: When using the mobile app, some mobile data may be used when loading features or updating your course progress. To prevent the use of any mobile data, we recommend turning mobile data usage off for the Udemy app from your device’s system settings.

To clear up your iOS device storage, please refer to our Help Center Article on deleting downloaded courses for offline viewing on the Udemy mobile app.

Learn how to troubleshoot download issues on the Udemy mobile app.

How to Access Course Resources on the iOS App

This article explains how to download course resources on the Udemy iOS App. To help keep track of your mobile storage, we also provide instructions on how to set up a notification before downloading large course lecture resources.

  • Accessing Udemy on a different device? Learn how to download course resources on a browser or how to download course resources on the Android app.

How to view and download resources by course lecture

After accessing the mobile course player, lectures that include supplementary resources will have Resources listed under the lecture title.

To access the resources, tap on the lecture title and hold for a moment or two. An options menu will appear. Tap on Resources for Lectures.

A list of the available resources will come up. Tap the resource text or Open to access the link or file.

After accessing a file, please follow the steps provided on your device to download the resource onto your mobile phone.

How to view and download all course resources

You can also find downloadable course resources for each lecture, all in one central place.

  1. Once you have accessed the mobile course player, tap More.

  2. Tap Resources.

  3. A list of lectures with available resources will come up. Tap on any lecture, and then tap the resource text or Open to access the link or file.

Set a notification before downloading large lecture resources

To keep track of your mobile storage, you can set a notification to confirm before downloading large resources from course lectures.

  1. After signing in to the Udemy mobile app, tap Account.

Coursera and Udemy combination

How the Udemy and Coursera combination will impact Udemy learners

As of May 11, Coursera and Udemy are now one company - read more - but we remain separate platforms for the time being.

Today, there are no changes to your experience on Udemy.

Over time, we plan to provide access to more courses and personalized, AI-powered learning experiences to help you build the right skills for your career.

When we introduce changes, we’ll communicate them clearly in advance so you know exactly what to expect. You can adjust your notification preferences to stay informed about future updates.

If you have questions about what this means for you, find your question in the article below.

How can I stay informed about future updates?

You can adjust your email communication preferences to stay informed of future updates.

To sign up for email updates:

  • Go to your Account settings.
  • Go to Notification Preferences.
  • Turn on ‘Updates and offerings’ and ‘Your learning.’
  • Click Save.

Will there be any subscription or pricing changes on Udemy?

As of today, there are no changes to subscriptions or pricing on Udemy.

Will I still have access to my courses, content, and subscription on Udemy?

Yes. You’ll continue to have access to:

  • Any courses (or other learning content) that you’ve enrolled in
  • Any certificates you’ve earned
  • Your active subscriptions

Will I get access to Coursera content if I have a subscription on Udemy?

Not yet. Coursera and Udemy will continue to operate as separate platforms for now. If you’re interested in subscribing to Coursera, visit coursera.org.

To stay informed of future updates, you can adjust your email communication preferences.

Will Udemy and Coursera become one platform?

Today, there are no changes to either the Coursera or Udemy platform.

Over time, you’ll begin to see expanded access to a broader, combined catalog across our platforms, along with a suite of AI-powered tools and experiences to help you build the right skills to grow your career.

We’ll share updates as changes are introduced, so you know what to expect.

Will the courses or content on Udemy change?

No. There are no changes to the content on Udemy today, and we’ll continue to expand our catalog to deliver learning content that helps you build the latest career-relevant skills.

What happens to my data and privacy?

We remain committed to data privacy and security. We continue to follow our Privacy Policy and safeguards to keep your information secure.

Will my account or login change?

No. Your Udemy account and login information remain the same.

Will anything happen to my Certificates or account history?

No. You will continue to have access to the Certificates you’ve earned, as well as your course progress and achievements.

I have both a Udemy and a Coursera account. Can I merge them?

Not at this time. Udemy and Coursera accounts, as well as the platforms, will continue to operate separately for now.

You can keep using both accounts as you do today. If we introduce ways to connect or merge accounts in the future, we’ll share details and make the process simple and secure.

What happens to my lifetime Marketplace course access?

You will continue to have lifetime access to any marketplace courses you’ve purchased or free courses you’ve enrolled in, subject to our Terms of Use. There are no current plans to change this lifetime access policy.

How does this affect my organization’s learning program?

If you’re part of an organization’s learning program, your program is not affected today and you still have access to the same learning content.

How to chat with “Alex”, Udemy’s virtual agent

This article outlines how you can connect with Udemy Support’s virtual agent, “Alex”, and includes tips you can follow to help ensure you have a quick and productive chat!

Please note: currently, “Alex” can only be accessed while reviewing English, French, German, Portuguese, Spanish, or Turkish articles in our Help Center. In the coming months, we plan to make the virtual agent available in all of the Help Center languages we support.

  • Issues with the Contact Us button? Please try clearing your cache and cookies. Be sure to restart your browser before trying again. Learn more about troubleshooting website issues on Udemy.com.
  • For security purposes, if you’re accessing Udemy.com from a public or shared device, please be sure to log out of your Udemy account and close your browser to close the chat, when you’ve completed your learning experience.

Table of contents

  • What is “Alex”?
  • How to connect with “Alex”
  • Chatting with “Alex”: Tips and best practices
  • Having trouble accessing “Alex”?
  • How can I change the language “Alex” is corresponding with me in?

What is “Alex”?

“Alex” is Udemy Support’s virtual agent that has been trained to quickly answer a wide range of questions you may have about Udemy, and to help resolve issues you may be encountering with our platform.

Please note that “Alex” is a virtual agent, powered by Ultimate, and is not human. If you need more help or can’t find the solution during your chat, however, “Alex” can easily guide you through the process of sending an email ticket to Udemy Support. We will follow up by email as soon as we have an update available.

How to connect with “Alex”

You can begin chatting with “Alex” by clicking “Contact Us”. If you’re on a laptop or desktop while viewing the Help Center, “Contact Us” appears on the right-side of any article.

If you’re viewing the Help Center on a mobile browser, “Contact Us” appears at the bottom of the article.

Chatting with “Alex”: Tips and best practices

Here are some tips and best practices we recommend you follow to help ensure you have a quick and productive chat with “Alex”.

Enter your question or the issue you’re encountering in just a few words. “Alex” is more likely to get confused and not understand questions that are lengthy and have extensive text.

Do not enter or paste a URL into the conversation unless you’ve been prompted to do so. Providing a URL (e.g. for a course, lecture or image) when one hasn’t been requested will likely confuse “Alex”.

Wait for “Alex” to respond to you and then select from one of the options presented if applicable. This will help prevent “Alex” from restarting or repeating the same question or statement.

If there are no options presented and “Alex” has asked you to provide more information or to enter another question, then please type your message. As noted above, we advise doing so with just a few words.

Having trouble accessing “Alex”?

If you are experiencing difficulties activating “Alex,” please try refreshing the page. If the problem continues, clear your browser’s cache and cookies.

If you are continuing to experience issues, please review our troubleshooting steps for website issues.

How can I change the language “Alex” is corresponding with me in?

As noted above, currently, “Alex” is only accessible while reviewing English, French, German, Portuguese, Spanish, or Turkish articles in our Help Center, and the virtual assistant can correspond in any of those languages.

So, for example, if you click “Contact Us” while reviewing an article in Portuguese, “Alex” should correspond with you in Portuguese. If you wish to correspond with the virtual assistant in another language that is supported, simply change your Help Center language preference to the applicable language and start a new chat session by clicking “Contact Us”.

How to contact Udemy Support

Our Help Center has extensive support articles and troubleshooting resources to assist you with questions or issues you may have regarding Udemy. You can quickly look for answers to your questions by entering keywords into the search bar at the top of the page.

But, if you’re still unable to resolve your issue, this article outlines how you can connect with Udemy Support. Our team will be happy to help!

If you want to report illegal content, please use this form. For all other inquiries, see below.

  • Issues with the Contact Us button? Please try clearing your cache and cookies. Be sure to restart your browser before trying again. Learn more about troubleshooting website issues on Udemy.com.

Table of contents

  • How to connect with Udemy Support

  • What to expect after submitting an email ticket

How to connect with Udemy Support

To begin the process of connecting with Udemy Support, simply click on the “Contact Us” button that appears on any Help Center article.

If you’re on a laptop or desktop while viewing the Help Center, “Contact Us” appears on the right-side of any article, including this one.

If you’re viewing the Help Center on a mobile browser, “Contact Us” appears at the bottom of the article.

Please note: Learners and instructors who are reviewing articles in the English, German, Portuguese, Spanish or Turkish versions of our Help Center will be connected with Udemy’s virtual agent, “Alex”, after clicking on “Contact Us”.

Although “Alex” is a virtual agent and is not human, if you need more help, “Alex” can easily guide you through the process of sending an email ticket to Udemy Support.

  • Learn how to chat with “Alex”, Udemy’s virtual agent.

Issues with the “Contact Us” button

If you encounter issues with the “Contact Us” button, please try clearing your cache and cookies to resolve the issue.

If you are continuing to experience issues, please review our troubleshooting steps for website issues.

What to expect after submitting an email ticket

After submitting an email ticket, you should receive a confirmation email from Udemy Support in your inbox. Our team aims to respond to all queries as quickly as possible.

Please note that response times can vary, based on the nature and complexity of the issue. Rest assured, our team is diligently working on your case and will provide you with an update.

Did not receive a confirmation email?

Please make sure to check your email inbox for a confirmation message that your ticket has been received. Be sure to check your spam, junk, or other folders, as our email may have been filtered there. You can find the ticket by searching for “udemy.com” in your inbox.

If you are accessing “Alex,” we recommend using your ticket number at the end of your conversation to search for your inquiry. If you cannot remember your ticket number, you can still find the ticket by searching for “udemy.com.”

Updating your request

If you need to provide additional information or have further questions, please reply to the email sent to your inbox. Please avoid submitting multiple email tickets regarding the same issue, as this will help our team assist you more efficiently.

About Udemy

What is Udemy?

Udemy’s mission is to create new possibilities for people and organizations everywhere. Our global marketplace features an extensive, multi-language library, which includes thousands of courses taught by real-world experts. You can take courses across a wide range of categories, some of which include: business & entrepreneurship, programming, academics, the arts, health & fitness, language, music, and more!

What do Udemy courses include?

The foundation of each Udemy course is its lectures, which can include videos, slides, and text. Each Udemy course is created, owned, and managed by the instructor(s). In addition, instructors can add resources and various types of practice activities, as a way to enhance the learning experience of students.

What are course variations?

As learners on Udemy have a wide range of learning goals, some instructors have enabled course variations, or multiple variations of a course.

If an instructor has made course variations available, you will typically see these options listed on the course landing page before you enroll.

You can also purchase additional variations at any time. Each variation will appear in your account as a separate course, and you’ll receive lifetime access to each one.

These course variations may be visible on the course landing page of a course you’ve already purchased, or a course you’re interested in purchasing. For more details about what each variation includes or which one is right for you, we recommend reviewing the course landing page.

What happens if an instructor creates variations of a course I have purchased?

Lifetime access

One of the best things about Udemy is that you can login to your account from virtually anywhere, whenever you want, and access your courses easily! We strongly believe that students will benefit from the limitless educational possibilities this feature presents.

Once you purchase a course, you’ll have access for life, provided that your account is in good standing and Udemy continues to have a license to that course.

Commonly asked questions

Below are answers to questions we often receive regarding lifetime access.

  • Will I continue to have access to the course even after I complete it?
  • I bought the course on sale. Does this affect how long I have access to the course?
  • Do free courses offer lifetime access?
  • Will I have lifetime access to subscription content?
  • What if I used an instructor coupon to purchase the course? Does lifetime access still apply?
  • What happens if the instructor removes the course from Udemy?
  • Can my courses ever be removed from Udemy?
  • Is lifetime access for previously purchased courses impacted by course variations?

Will I continue to have access to the course even after I complete it?

Yes. You will continue to have access to the course after you complete it, provided that your account’s in good standing, and Udemy continues to have a license to the course. So, if you wish to review specific content in the course after you finish it, or take it all over again, you can.

I bought the course on sale. Does this affect how long I have access to the course?

No. Your access to a course is not affected by the price you paid for it.

Do free courses offer lifetime access?

Yes. Students also receive lifetime access to free courses, provided their account remains in good standing and Udemy continues to have a license to the course.

Will I have lifetime access to subscription content?

You will have unlimited access to subscription content as long as you have an active subscription. If you cancel your subscription, you will have access to the subscription content until the final date of your billing period, which is posted on your Subscriptions page.

What if I used an instructor coupon to purchase the course? Does lifetime access still apply?

Yes. Students receive lifetime access to a Udemy course regardless of what price they paid for it, or whether they used a coupon to enrol or not.

What happens if the instructor removes the course from Udemy?

We host thousands of courses on our online learning marketplace. Our marketplace model means we do not own the copyright to the content of the courses; the respective instructors own these rights. On rare occasions, instructors may remove their courses from our marketplace, or, Udemy may have to remove a course from the platform for policy or legal reasons. If this does happen to a course you’re enrolled in, please contact us and we’ll be ready to help.

Please note: occasionally instructors may decide to unpublish their course and close it to additional enrollments. For example, an instructor might unpublish an older course until they’ve had a chance to update the course content. In situations where an instructor unpublishes their course, however, the course content remains on the platform and is still accessible to students who are enrolled in the course.

Can my courses ever be removed from Udemy?

On rare occasions, Udemy may be required to remove a course from the platform due to policy or legal reasons. If this does happen to a course you’re enrolled in, please contact us and we’ll be ready to help.

Is lifetime access for previously purchased courses impacted by course variations?

Previously purchased courses are not impacted by course variations. You will retain lifetime access to the course you previously purchased, provided that your account is in good standing, and Udemy continues to have a license to the course.

Please note: Refunds for course variations are also covered under Udemy’s Refund Policy.

  • Learn more about course variations

Assignments: Apply Your Knowledge and Improve the Skills You’ve Learned With Udemy!

This article explains the process of completing assignments, which are a great way to apply your knowledge and improve the skills you’ve learned. If you wish, you can also learn from fellow learners by receiving feedback on your assignments, or by sharing your thoughts on theirs.

Please note:

  • Assignments cannot be manually marked or unmarked as complete. If you have completed your assignment and do not see a checkmark, please try refreshing the course player after completing the steps below.
  • Currently, assignments are not supported on the mobile app. To take and complete an assignment, please complete it while accessing your course on a desktop or laptop computer.

Table of Contents

  • Completing an Assignment
    • Instructions
    • Submission
  • Instructor Example
  • Give Feedback
  • Completing Your Assignment And Viewing Feedback
  • Commonly Asked Questions

Completing an Assignment

Assignments are posted in the curriculum of the course. Just like lectures, you can begin an assignment by clicking on it in the curriculum accessible from the left-hand side in the video player, or on the course dashboard in the Course Content section.

Please note: Assignments do not need to be completed in order to complete the course. You can move forward without having a checkmark on them and you will still receive a certificate.

Once you have clicked on the assignment you will see the assignment title, and the amount of time the instructor thinks it will take for you to complete it. In addition, the assignment feature comes with a “save draft” option, so if you run out of time, you can save what you’ve entered and finish the assignment later.

You can begin the assignment by clicking on Start Assignment in the bottom right-hand corner of the screen.

Once you have begun the assignment, you can proceed through each section by clicking on Next at the bottom right of the page, or on the section title at the top.

Each assignment includes the following sections:

Instructions

In the instructions section, the instructor will outline what the assignment entails and what you will need to do to complete it. If the instructor has included any additional resources for you to refer to, they will also be included on this page.

Once you’re ready to complete your assignment, click on Submission at the top of the page, or Next at the bottom right.

Submission

The submission section is where you can enter your answers or add the content (image, code or external link) that the assignment requires. If at any point you want to save your assignment, and return to it at a later time, click on Save Draft at the bottom left hand of the page. What you have completed thus far will be saved.

Once your assignment is finished, you can Choose your sharing preference by selecting whether you want to share with and receive feedback from your peers.

If you have saved your submission as a draft and haven’t submitted it yet, you can return to it at anytime by clicking on Submission at the top.

If your assignment is finished and you’re ready to submit it to the instructor, click on Submit at the bottom left of the page.

Please note: Submission for each question must be 65K characters or less. Images that are to be uploaded to a submission most be smaller than 30 MB in size, and can be in .JPG, .PNG, or .BMP file format.

To advance from the submission page to the instructor’s example, click on Instructor Example at the top of the page. If you need to review the instructions again, however, then simply click on Instructions at the top left.

Instructor Example

On the Instructor Example page, you can review the instructor’s answers or solutions and compare them to your own.

If you haven’t submitted your assignment, you can return to it by clicking on Submission at the top, or Add your Answer at the bottom of the page.

Give Feedback

Reviewing another student’s work and providing your feedback will likely improve your own understanding of the course. On this page, you can provide feedback on the assignments of up to three other students, who have chosen to share their work.

Completing Your Assignment And Viewing Feedback

Once you have submitted your assignment and have navigated through each section to the Give Feedback page, click on Complete Assignment at the bottom right.

After completing the assignment, your assignment should be marked as complete with a checkmark. If you do not see a checkbox next to your assignment, please try refreshing your page.

Please note: Assignments cannot be resubmitted or unmarked as complete.

After the course instructor or other students post feedback on your assignment (if you have opted to share it with them), you will receive a notification from Udemy. The notification will include a link to the summary page that features the feedback.

Once feedback has been posted on your assignment, you can also review it at anytime, by returning to the assignment and clicking on Go to feedback at the bottom.

Commonly Asked Questions

How can I tell if a course includes assignments?

If an instructor has included assignments in the course then this will be indicated on the course landing page.

Why is my assignment not getting marked as complete (no checkmark)?

If you have completed all of the above steps, please try refreshing your Course player browser.

Do I need to submit the assignment in order to complete the course?

No. You do not need to submit the assignment in order to complete the course and receive a certificate of completion.

Is the instructor required to post feedback on my assignment?

No. While we encourage instructors to engage with students when possible, they are not required to post feedback on your assignment. Just remember that you can also review the instructor’s own answers, examples or solutions for the assignment in the Instructor Example section.

Can I redo my assignment once I’ve submitted it?

No. Once an assignment has been submitted to the instructor it cannot be edited or redone. You can, however, go back and review what you submitted as well as the instructor’s solutions.

Do I need to provide feedback on other students’ assignments?

No. You’re not required to share your assignment with your fellow students or provide feedback on theirs.

What is Connect 1-1 ?

Learners can choose from hundreds of top Udemy instructors from a wide variety of industries and backgrounds, ranging from Tech and AI to Business professionals.

How do I sign up for Connect 1-1?

You can view your upcoming and past Connect 1-1 sessions on your bookings page. To access it, click My Udemy Connect Bookings under your profile icon.

When it’s time for your session, click Join Call to start.

Please note: We recommend downloading and testing Zoom before your session to help ensure better audio and video quality and that all the features are working correctly

  • Visit the Zoom Download Center to learn more.

How do I cancel or reschedule my Connect 1-1 session?

On your bookings page, click Cancel booking to cancel your session. You can then rebook for another available session time.

Please note: If you cancel less than 48 hours before a booked session, you will not be eligible for a refund. If you fail to attend a scheduled session, you will also not be eligible for a refund. Learn more about Udemy’s refund policy.

What is the refund policy for Connect 1-1?

The refund policy for Connect 1-1 services is different from the policy for Udemy courses. For detailed information, learn about Udemy’s refund policy.

How much does Connect 1-1 cost?

Pricing for coaching is set by each instructor. You can view specific rates when signing up for a session.

Can credits be used to purchase a session?

Yes, Udemy credits can be used to purchase coaching services and will automatically be applied at the time of purchase.

Please note: Once used, Udemy credits cannot be exchanged or reversed to a different payment method.

  • View frequently asked questions about Udemy credits.

Do all instructors offer coaching?

No, not all instructors offer coaching services at this time. To see if your instructor provides this option, please check your course player for available coaching services.

Cannot access my sessions on Udemy.com

If you are unable to access your coaching sessions on Udemy.com, please ensure you have a stable internet connection and that you are logged into the correct Udemy account.

  • Review troubleshooting steps for issues with Udemy.com.

Technical issues during a session

If you experience technical difficulties during your coaching session, please check your internet connection and make sure your microphone and camera permissions are enabled. If the issue continues, try rejoining the session using the Join Call button.

  • For help with video or audio issues, please visit the Zoom Help Center for troubleshooting tips and support.

What topics are available for Connect 1-1?

Connect 1-1 sessions range from content related to course material, to certification exam preparation or career advice. Connect 1-1 is offered by instructors teaching a variety of topics including business and technology.

How do I know if an instructor is qualified?

Coaches on the Udemy platform have high course ratings (4.0+ stars) and proven track records of helping learners succeed. We recommend reading their profiles, course reviews, and coaching-specific feedback before booking.

What should I prepare for my session?

Come prepared with specific questions or challenges you want to address. The more specific you can be about your goals, the more valuable your session will be.

Can I book multiple sessions with the same instructor?

Yes, if you find an instructor you like, you can book additional sessions with them. Many learners build ongoing relationships with their preferred instructors.

The Free Course Experience

Free courses on Udemy offer students a simplified learning experience. This simplified experience limits the features that are available in a free course compared to a paid course. For example, free courses do not offer a certificate of completion, and additional course features like the Q&A and direct messaging are not included in free course enrollments.

All of these features are available in our paid course offerings. If you want access to these additional features, we recommend enrolling in a paid course

Please note: Students who enroll in paid courses via promotional coupons, our gifting option, or Udemy credits will also have access to all the course features.

Free courses may include advertisements (ads). Ads may appear before, during, or after lessons, on course pages, and within the course player. Ads do not alter the course content and do not constitute an endorsement by Udemy. If you enrolled in a free course prior to March 17, 2020, you will retain access to Q&A and your certificate of completion for those free courses only. All new free course enrollments after March 16, 2020 will not have access to the additional features.

How to access the Udemy AI Assistant and ask questions about a specific course you’re taking

You can ask the Udemy AI Assistant to provide concept explanations and summaries about the course content, in-course labs, practice scenarios, code examples, and more.

  • Learn more about using the AI Assistant during practice tests.
  • Learn more about using the AI Assistant while taking an in-course lab. You can select from one of the preset prompts that is available, or enter your own question or request.

Exiting out of the Udemy AI Assistant

To navigate away from the Udemy AI Assistant and return to the course’s content curriculum, click Course content.

Encountering an issue with the course content or course player?

Please note that currently, the Udemy AI Assistant can not answer questions about technical issues you may encounter on the platform or if there is an issue with the course content.

If you encounter technical issues while taking a course, or encounter a problem with the course content itself, review steps you can take to have your question or issue resolved.

What to do if the Udemy AI Assistant is unable to answer your question

As noted above, the Udemy AI Assistant is trained to answer a specific range of questions regarding the content of specific courses.

When a question is asked outside the range of what’s expected, the Udemy AI Assistant will notify you if it’s unable to answer that question. We recommend asking questions closely related to learning and the specific content of the course you’re currently accessing.

If you wish to share feedback regarding your experience using the Udemy AI Assistant, please click “Share feedback” and fill out the feedback survey. The feedback will be sent to the applicable Udemy team directly and could help inform future improvements.

How to upload an image file to the Udemy AI Assistant

Learners can also upload image files directly into the Udemy AI Assistant to get help or answer questions related to the course content. Similarly to text questions, the image should be related to the course content. The Udemy AI Assistant will notify you if it’s unable to provide any information or answers related to the image you upload.

Image file requirements: In order for the image to be uploaded, it will need to meet the requirements listed below. If the image does not meet the requirements, an error notification will appear, or you may be prompted to upload a different image.

  • The image must be in one of the following formats: PNG (.png), JPEG (.jpg/.jpeg), WEBP (.webp), or non-animated GIFs (.gif).
    • Other file types like PDFs or Word documents aren’t supported at this time.
  • The maximum file size is 20MB.
  • The file cannot include a potentially unsafe or inappropriate image. Learn more about the rules for uploading or posting content to Udemy. You can upload an image by clicking the paper clip file icon beside the text input box.

Please note:

  • There is no limit on the number of image uploads you can do, and the images will be viewable in the chat history, just like any other question or message.
  • Images that are uploaded will not be visible to the course instructor or other learners enrolled in the course.

Exiting out of the Udemy AI Assistant

To navigate away from the Udemy AI Assistant and return to the course’s content curriculum, click Course content.

Image storage and privacy protection

Images uploaded into the Udemy AI Assistant are subject to the same privacy and security protections as your other Udemy platform data. Learn more.

How to use the Role Play feature

This article provides an overview of the Role Play feature, how to access and interact with the feature, as well as answers to frequently asked questions about it.

  • Udemy instructor? Learn how to create a Role Play for your course.

Table of contents

  • What is Role Play?

  • Which courses offer Role Play?

  • How to access Role Play

  • Interacting with the AI character

  • Reviewing your results Frequently asked questions

  • Does completing a Role Play contribute to whether a certificate of completion will be created when I complete a course?

  • What languages are Udemy Role Plays available in?

  • Can I access Role Plays on the Udemy mobile app?

  • I’m having trouble understanding or completing the goals for the Role Play. Who should I contact?

  • Is there a time limit for completing the Role Play exercise? Or how many times I can complete a Role Play?

  • Can I review feedback for the Role Play goals and session before I’ve completed it?

  • Does Udemy use learner personal data to train or fine-tune the GenAI models?

  • How does Role Play ensure the privacy and security of my data?

  • How does Role Play process, store, and delete user data?

What is Role Play?

Role Plays are an interactive feature that allows learners to practice their skills by engaging with an AI character in realistic scenarios.

In the beginning, you will receive an agenda with more information about the AI character you are speaking to and the meeting goals for your conversation. You can have a conversation, ask questions, and practice in a real-world situation.

Role Plays help you apply course learnings through hands-on practice, helping to build confidence and develop skills such as decision-making, problem-solving, and communication.

Which courses offer Role Play?

If a course offers a Role Play, this will be indicated on the course landing page, under the This course includes section.

How to access Role Play

If your course offers Role Play, you can access this section in your course curriculum.

Note: the Role Play feature is available while accessing applicable courses on both desktop and mobile web. It is not available in the mobile app.

Before starting a Role Play, you’ll see a screen displaying details about the scenario, the AI character, and the meeting’s goals. Once you have reviewed the information, click Start Role Play to begin the session.

Interacting with the AI character

Once you are in the meeting, the AI character will initiate the conversation. Your microphone will be on at the beginning of the conversation, but you can select the microphone icon at any time to disable it.

Please note: If you experience issues with the microphone, please ensure that your browser’s microphone settings are enabled. You can also use the chat feature that is mentioned below.

Access closed captions: You can click on the closed captions icon to view a live transcript of the conversation as it happens.

If you prefer, you can communicate with the AI character using text communication. To access the chat window, you can click the chat icon to the right of the microphone icon.

On the left-hand side, you can review context about the scenario, the goals, and information about the AI character.

When you are ready to end the conversation, click on the phone icon. Then, select See results.

Reviewing your results

At the end of your role play, you will receive a report detailing which goals you have completed. For each completed goal, you’ll receive an overview of your strengths and actionable tips to help improve your future conversations. If a goal was not completed, you’ll also see areas for improvement and examples to guide you in your next conversation.

Download conversation transcript: Click on the download icon to download a text transcription of your entire conversation.

To attempt the session again, click Practice again.

Providing feedback

To provide feedback on your Role Play experience, click on Share feedback on the sidebar. This is specifically to provide feedback on product improvements and not the content of the Role Play itself.

Frequently asked questions

Does completing a Role Play contribute to whether a certificate of completion will be created when I complete a course?

You do not need to complete a Role Play to finish a course. If the course offers a certificate of completion, you will be able to download your certificate after completing any required course items.

  • Learn how to download a certificate of completion.
What languages are Udemy Role Plays available in?

Udemy’s Role Plays feature is available in select languages. Learn more about supported languages for Udemy’s GenAI tools.

Can I access Role Plays on the Udemy mobile app?

No. As noted above, the Role Play feature is available while accessing applicable courses on both desktop and mobile web. It is not available in the mobile app.

I’m having trouble understanding or completing the goals for the Role Play. Who should I contact?

As courses are owned and managed by the instructors themselves, we recommend contacting the instructor directly if you’re having difficulty with the Role Play learning goals. They are the best prepared to resolve your issue or answer your question so you can resume your learning.

  • Technical issues? Learn how to troubleshoot website problems.
Is there a time limit for completing the Role Play exercise? Or how many times I can complete a Role Play?

While the course instructor provides a recommended time for the Role Play as a guide, there is no set time limit. The timer will continue, and you can end the exercise anytime by clicking End Role Play.

There are no limitations to how many times you can take and complete a Role Play.

Can I review feedback for the Role Play goals and session before I’ve completed it?

No. You can only review feedback for the Role Play’s goals and session once you have completed the scenario.

Does Udemy use learner personal data to train or fine-tune the GenAI models?

No, Udemy does not use learner personal data to train or fine tune GenAI models used for our GenAI features. Please see the “Generative AI Terms” section of our Terms of Use for more information.

How does Role Play ensure the privacy and security of my data?

Udemy is committed to the responsible development and deployment of AI technologies. We maintain robust controls for secure development practices, data handling, access management, and risk management to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our systems, services, and data. We do not use your personal data to train or fine-tune the GenAI models used for our GenAI features, subject to the Terms of Use, and our policy also prohibits vendors from training AI models using your data.

How does Role Play process, store, and delete user data?

Role Play processes a minimal amount of personal data, including for example, your input (whether voice audio or text) and usage metrics. Role Play personal data is deleted when the learner’s account is closed.

The Udemy ChatGPT app allows you to search for Udemy courses directly within ChatGPT. You can look up a topic, view course search results, watch preview videos, and explore course curriculums. How to access the Udemy ChatGPT App

The Udemy app is available directly within ChatGPT. No additional download or browser extension is required. See the frequently asked questions below for more information on app availability.

You can access the Udemy app within ChatGPT one of two ways:

  • Use the @Udemy command within a chat to find and select the Udemy app.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need a Udemy account to use the Udemy ChatGPT app?

You don’t need to be logged into a Udemy account in order to discover and preview courses on the Udemy ChatGPT app. Your Udemy and ChatGPT accounts will not be linked to each other.

However, you’ll need to log in or create a Udemy account to enroll in or access paid Udemy content.

  • See how to sign up or how to log in to Udemy.
Which ChatGPT plan do I need to use this feature?

The Udemy app is designed to work with various ChatGPT plans. Access to the app depends on your ChatGPT plan and its availability through OpenAI. Please note that eligibility is determined by OpenAI.

Can I use the ChatGPT app to work through Udemy courses I’ve purchased or have access to?

No, course content itself can only be accessed and completed on Udemy.com or the Udemy mobile app.

Will ChatGPT only surface courses that are new to me?

As the ChatGPT app doesn’t have access to your Udemy account, the search results may include courses that you already own or have completed.

Is my search activity from ChatGPT shared with Udemy?

Udemy receives only the minimum information needed to provide recommendations and handle enrollments. ChatGPT usage data is governed by OpenAI’s policies.

Who should I contact if I’m having issues using the Udemy ChatGPT app?

Practice Tests: Frequently Asked Questions

This article includes answers to frequently asked questions regarding Udemy’s practice test feature, which provides comprehensive, long-form simulated exams for learners to assess their knowledge of a particular subject.

Frequently asked questions regarding practice tests

Here are answers to frequently asked questions regarding practice tests.

  • How will I know which courses offer these exams?
  • Is there an additional charge to take the practice test?
  • Will I be notified if I take longer than the time allotted to complete the exam?
  • How can I review my answers?
  • Will instructors be able to see my practice test answers and score?
  • What is the difference between a practice test and a practice test course?
  • What is the difference between practice mode and exam mode?
  • How do I create a practice test or practice test course?
  • Do practice test-only courses offer Certificates of Completion?

How will I know which courses offer these exams?

To learn how to locate and complete practice tests, please visit the applicable Help Center article below:

  • Browser instructions
  • Mobile instructions

Is there an additional charge to take the practice test?

No. If a course offers a practice test it will be included in the course purchase. You will not need to pay any additional fee to take the practice test.

Will I be notified if I take longer than the time allotted to complete the exam?

Yes. The practice tests include a timer, which is set to match the same amount of time that’s allowed for the official, certifying exam. If you go past the time allotted, the practice test will alert you.

How can I review my answers?

You can review all the answers you submitted by clicking on Review questions after you’ve completed an exam, and see which questions you got right or wrong. You can also search through them for specific subjects in the exam using the Knowledge Areas filter. By clicking on the All Questions filter you’ll be able to select the questions you would like to review (correct, incorrect, skipped, marked for review.)

Will instructors be able to see my practice test answers and score?

No. Only the learner can view their answers and final score.

What is the difference between a practice test and a practice test course?

While a practice test is a feature available in select Udemy courses, practice test courses only include practice tests. These courses do not include other curriculum items like lectures and quizzes.

What is the difference between practice mode and exam mode?

Practice mode is an untimed, flexible way for you to practice. You can select which domain(s) you’d like to focus on, find out if you got a question right or wrong right away, and learn from the detailed answer feedback.

Exam mode is a timed experience designed to mimic the real test-taking experience.

How do I create a practice test or practice test course?

Learn more about creating a practice test or practice test course as an instructor.

Do practice test-only courses offer Certificates of Completion?

No. Currently, courses that only include practice tests, and no other curriculum items like lectures or quizzes do not offer a Certificate of Completion.

Taking Practice Tests

Udemy’s practice test feature provides comprehensive, long-form simulated exams for students to assess their knowledge of a particular subject. This article explains how to access and take practice tests.

  • Accessing Udemy on the mobile app? Learn how to take practice tests on the Udemy mobile app.

Table of contents
