Pix: Frequently asked questions

This article includes answers to frequently asked questions regarding Pix, which is a payment method learners located in Brazil can use to make purchases on Udemy.

  • Learn how to use pix as a payment method on Udemy.
  • Learn more about other payment methods that are available on Udemy.

Frequently asked questions regarding Pix

  • How can I pay with Pix on Udemy?
  • I paid for my Pix today but I still can’t access my course. What can I do?
  • I want a refund and I paid via Pix; how will it be sent?
  • I changed my mind; I would like to purchase the course with a different payment method. Can I do that?
  • I have two Pix payments for the same course; what should I do?
  • Can I choose the due date for my Pix?
  • Can I pay my Pix after its due date?
  • I didn’t pay my Pix in time; can I still pay for a course with another Pix?
  • Do I need to provide proof that the Pix is paid so you can add the course to my account? Or, if I provide proof that the Pix was paid, can you add the course to my account?
  • I paid for my Pix a couple of days ago, but I still don’t have the course in my account. What should I do?

How can I pay with Pix on Udemy?

Learn how to use Pix as a payment method on Udemy.

I paid for my Pix today but I still can’t access my course. What can I do?

After Udemy receives confirmation the payment’s been completed, your purchases will appear in your Udemy account. Generally speaking, this should not take longer than 30 minutes. In some cases, however, it may take longer before the transaction is processed.

If you notice your Pix payment is still pending after 24 hours, please contact Udemy Support and provide a receipt showing that the Pix was paid, so we can assist you further.

I want a refund and I paid via Pix; how will it be sent?

Purchases made with Pix are eligible for credit refunds, provided the request meets the guidelines in our refund policy. Learn how to submit a refund request.

I changed my mind; I would like to purchase the course with a different payment method. Can I do that?

Yes. If you have not paid the Pix yet, then you can make the purchase using a credit card. If you purchase the course using another payment method, then simply do not pay the Pix that you generated for the course initially.

I have two Pix payments for the same course; what should I do?

If you have issued two Pix payments for the same course, but have paid for one of them, then no further action is required. You will be able to access the course.

If you haven’t paid for either Pix, however, then you will be unable to start the course until you have paid for one of them. Once you have paid one Pix then you can ignore the other one.

If you have paid for two Pix payments for the same course, however, then please contact Udemy Support to initiate a refund.

Can I choose the due date for my Pix?

No. Once you have issued a Pix for a purchase, we recommend paying the Pix within 5 days to prevent it from expiring. If the Pix expires, however, you can get another one to make the purchase or use a different payment method.

Can I pay my Pix after its due date?

No. We recommend paying the Pix within 5 days to prevent it from expiring. If the Pix expires, however, you will need to get another one for the purchase or use a different payment method.

I didn’t pay my Pix in time; can I still pay for a course with another Pix?

Yes. We recommend paying the Pix within 5 days to prevent it from expiring. If the Pix payment expires, however, you can get another one for the purchase.

Do I need to provide proof that the Pix is paid so you can add the course to my account? Or, if I provide proof that the Pix was paid, can you add the course to my account?

No. The course you purchased with Pix is added to your Udemy account automatically after we receive confirmation from our payment processor that the Pix was paid.

Generally speaking, this should not take longer than 30 minutes. In some cases, however, it may take longer before the transaction is processed. If you notice your Pix payment is still pending after 24 hours, please contact Udemy Support and provide a receipt showing that the Pix was paid, so we can assist you further.

I paid for my Pix a couple of days ago, but I still don’t have the course in my account. What should I do?

If you experience a delay past 24 hours in receiving your course, please contact Udemy Support and provide a receipt showing that the Pix was paid.

Purchasing on Udemy with Boleto Bancario

In addition to our other payment methods, learners located in Brazil can make purchases on Udemy using Boleto Bancário. This article outlines how you can use boleto on Udemy as a payment method.

  • For answers to common questions we receive about Boleto Bancário, please review our FAQ.

How to make purchases on Udemy with Boleto Bancário

Please follow the steps below to use Boleto Bancário as your payment method on Udemy.

  • During the checkout process, click on “Boleto” and then “Pay With Boleto Bancario”.
  • Confirm that you wish to pay using a boleto.
  • Review the boleto terms at the bottom of the page.
  • Click on “Finalize Payment” and you will be directed to the bank owned page to receive your boleto.
  • Enter your CPF number and name.
  • A boleto will be displayed on a separate window with the payment details.
  • The boleto can be taken to a bank for payment or paid online via internet banking. You can also take the boleto to a retail outlet and make a cash payment. You can print the boleto by clicking on print under the “File” tab, or you can also take a screenshot of it and print it later. If your boleto is still pending, and you need to download it later, you can do so by navigating to your purchase history and clicking Download.
  • If you purchased one or more Udemy courses, they will appear in your My learning page, after Udemy receives confirmation the payment’s been completed. Generally, this takes one business day. Please note: We recommend paying the boleto within 5 days to prevent it from expiring. After you pay the boleto, you will receive an email confirming that the boleto was paid, and that you now have access to the course.

If the boleto expires, however, you can get another one for the course or use a different payment method to purchase it.

Accessing the Boleto in your Purchase History

If you need to download the boleto again for your course purchase, you can also access it in your Purchase History, by following the steps below:

  • Navigate to your account avatar at the top right hand of the page.
  • Click on Purchase History from the dropdown menu.
  • Click on Download to the right of Boleto Bancario, which will appear under Payment Type.
  • You will be redirected from Udemy and asked to confirm your CPF.
  • Click Validate and you will proceed to the original payment page.
  • Click Boleto Bancario and the boleto will generate again.
  • You can print the boleto by clicking on print under the File tab. The boleto can then be taken to a bank for payment or paid online via internet banking. Please note: we suggest paying the boleto within 5 business days to avoid it expiring.

Have additional questions about Boleto Bancário?

For more information about how Boleto Bancário works on Udemy, and for answers to commonly asked questions regarding it, please review our FAQ article.

Purchasing on Udemy with Oxxo

In addition to our other payment methods, learners located in Mexico can make purchases on Udemy.com using Oxxo. This article includes answers to frequently asked questions regarding Oxxo and how the payment method works.

Table of contents

  • How can I make purchases on Udemy with Oxxo?
  • I want a refund and I paid with Oxxo. How will the refund be sent?
  • I paid for my Oxxo voucher today but I still can’t access my course. What can I do?
  • I paid my Oxxo voucher several days ago, but I still don’t have the course in my account. What should I do?
  • Can I pay for my Oxxo after its due date?
  • I didn’t pay my Oxxo voucher in time; can I still pay for a course with another voucher?
  • I changed my mind. I would like to purchase the course with a different payment method. Can I do that?
  • I paid for my Oxxo but the course still isn’t accessible in my account. If I provide proof that the voucher was paid, can Udemy add the course to my account?

How can I make purchases on Udemy with Oxxo?

  1. If Oxxo is one of the payment methods available to you on Udemy.com, you will see the option to use it as your payment method on the checkout page.

  2. After selecting Oxxo as your payment method, you will need to enter your CURP number, before you can proceed to a secure server that will generate your voucher and barcode.

  3. You can save and print the voucher via your mobile device, and the voucher will also be accessible via your Purchase history page. Once payment has been completed for the voucher, or the voucher has expired, it will no longer be available in your Purchase history.

  4. Present the voucher and barcode at an Oxxo store to make the payment for your purchase. Please note that you will have 3 days to complete the payment before the voucher expires.

  • After you complete your payment at the store, you will be provided a printed receipt so that you can verify that your payment has been made correctly if needed.
  1. Once Udemy receives confirmation that the payment has been completed, your course(s) should be available in your account within 24 hours.

I want a refund and I paid with Oxxo. How will the refund be sent?

Purchases with Oxxo are eligible for credit refunds, provided the request meets the guidelines in our refund policy. Learn how to submit a refund request.

I paid my Oxxo voucher today but I still can’t access my course. What can I do?

Once Udemy receives confirmation that the payment has been completed, your course(s) should be available in your account within 24 hours.

I paid my Oxxo voucher several days ago, but I still don’t have the course in my account. What should I do?

If you paid the Oxxo voucher several days ago, but you still don’t see the course under your Udemy account, please contact Udemy Support and provide your receipt showing that the voucher was paid.

Can I pay my Oxxo voucher after its due date?

No. The voucher must be paid within 3 days to prevent it from expiring. If the Oxxo voucher expires you will need to get another one for the course or use a different payment method to purchase it.

I didn’t pay my Oxxo voucher in time; can I still pay for a course with another voucher?

Yes. If you don’t pay for the Oxxo voucher within 3 days and it expires, you can get another one for the course by following the steps outlined above.

I changed my mind. I would like to purchase the course with a different payment method. Can I do that?

Yes. If you have not paid the Oxxo voucher yet, then you can purchase the course using another payment method. If you decided to purchase the course using another payment method, then simply do not pay for the voucher that you submitted for the course initially.

I paid for my Oxxo but the course still isn’t accessible in my account. If I provide proof that the voucher was paid, can Udemy add the course to my account?

No. The course you purchased with Oxxo will be added to your Udemy account automatically after we receive confirmation from our payment processor that the voucher was paid. As noted above, once Udemy receives confirmation that the payment has been completed, your course(s) should be available in your account within 24 hours.

Shopping cart FAQ

This article includes answers to frequently asked questions we receive regarding the shopping cart feature, which is an easy way to purchase multiple courses at once.

  • How do I use the shopping cart?

How do I use the shopping cart?

Learn how to use the shopping cart and begin your learning experience

How many courses can I put in my cart?

You can add up to 50 courses in your shopping cart.

How many coupon codes can I apply to the courses in my cart?

You can apply an unlimited number of coupons to the courses in your cart.

What’s the difference between Save for Later and the Wishlist?

You can wishlist a course by clicking on the Wishlist heart on the course landing page or by clicking Move to Wishlist on the checkout page. By adding it to your wishlist you can easily remember what course(s) caught your attention.

You can only save a course for later, however, from the checkout page. Use the Save for Later option when you’re not ready to purchase the course now. When your return to your shopping cart, click Move to cart from your Saved for Later list to purchase the course.

I had a few courses in my cart a couple of months ago but they’re not in my cart anymore. What happened?

After 30 days of being in your cart (with no purchase), courses will move from your cart to your Saved for Later list. To move the courses back to your cart, click Move to Cart.

I entered a Udemy coupon code. Why didn’t the course prices change?

Udemy site-wide coupon codes are automatically applied to your cart. Coupon codes that have been applied to your course(s) appear under the coupon code submission field. You can also hover over the coupon icon next to the course title in the cart to see the coupon that was applied to the course.

I entered in a coupon code from an instructor. How do I know which course it applies to?

Hover over the coupon icon next to the price to see which coupon code has applied to the course. If you enter multiple coupon codes for a course, the coupon that gives you the greatest discount will be applied.

I just want to purchase one course. Do I have to use the shopping cart?

No. If you want to purchase just one course, click Buy Now and enter your payment information. Alternatively, you can click Add to Cart to check out with a single course in the cart.

Taxes: Student FAQ

Udemy has a legal obligation to collect applicable transaction taxes including VAT (Value Added Tax), GST (Goods & Services Tax), or other types of sales taxes, for purchases, which may vary depending on a student’s local, state, and country jurisdiction. This article includes answers to frequently asked questions we receive regarding taxes for Udemy purchases.

Who has to pay transaction taxes on Udemy purchases?

Students who reside in regions that collect transaction taxes like VAT, GST, or other types of sales taxes may be required to pay a tax when they make a purchase on the Udemy platform. Taxes are calculated based on a variety of factors such as account and billing information.

Udemy reserves the right to change this policy to be in compliance with tax requirements at any time.

How can I preview how much transaction tax will be charged?

During the checkout process, any applicable taxes will be included in your order total before you are charged. The tax amount that was charged will be indicated in your receipt and the tax rate will be reflected in the transaction’s invoice.

Depending on the region you live in and the tax being collected, tax will be included in the display price or included in the total. For example, students purchasing courses in tax-inclusive countries will see the tax included in the course price. So, if the course is priced at £19.99, then the student would pay £19.99 for the purchase.

Students purchasing courses in tax-exclusive countries will see the tax displayed on the checkout page as “Estimated Tax”.

Where can I see how much transaction tax was charged after I make a Udemy purchase?

When you complete a purchase on Udemy, you will be sent a receipt via email, which will break down the purchase price and taxes separately. The amount you paid will be shown on your receipt beside Tax.

Where can I get an invoice?

You can quickly access an invoice for your purchase one by heading to the Purchase history in your account. Learn more about Udemy invoices.

Is it possible to get receipts without the transaction tax amount that was charged shown? Or can Udemy remit the transaction taxes I paid?

Due to legal obligations we must show the amount of tax that was charged for each transaction. We will not be able to remove tax amounts from receipts. As Udemy.com is a business to consumer website, we are not able to remove references to taxes from our receipts or invoices.

If a customer wants a receipt or invoice without taxes included because they are a business and therefore do not pay taxes, they would need to sign up for a Udemy Business account. If you are a business that is interested in the Udemy Business platform, you can learn more here.

What are Udemy’s Taxpayer Identification Number and VAT ID?

Udemy’s Taxpayer Identification Number is 27-1779864. Our VAT ID is EU372008054.

How are Udemy courses priced?

For answers to some of the most frequently asked questions we receive regarding how Udemy courses are priced, please click here.

Udemy does not provide tax, legal, accounting, or other professional advice or services. Udemy’s services are not intended to provide, and should not be relied on for, such advice or services. You should consult your own tax, legal, accounting, or other professional advisors for this type of advice or service.

Udemy coupons: FAQ

The article answers frequently asked questions about Udemy coupons and coupon codes and how you can redeem a coupon you’ve received for a Udemy course or subscription.

Frequently asked questions

  • How can I get a Udemy coupon or a discount code?
  • What’s the difference between a Udemy coupon code and an instructor coupon code?
  • How do I use a coupon code on Udemy?
  • Why is my Udemy coupon not showing?
  • Why did the discount price change for my course or subscription?
  • Why do I see “Sorry, this course is not included in this promotion” when I try to redeem the coupon code?
  • How long are coupon codes good for?
  • Why can’t I enter coupon codes on the Udemy mobile app?
  • I recently purchased a course but now have a coupon code that will discount the course price to lower than what I paid. What can I do?

How can I get a Udemy coupon or a discount code?

Udemy coupon codes come from promotions Udemy routinely runs on the Udemy website, www.udemy.com. These coupon codes are automatically applied to eligible courses and subscriptions when you select them for checkout.

We frequently run promotions on the platform. To help keep track and to make sure you don’t miss a sale, we recommend confirming you are subscribed to promotional emails in your notification settings.

  • Learn how to review your notification settings for promotional emails. Instructors are another source of coupon codes as they can create and distribute coupon codes for their own promotions.

What’s the difference between a Udemy coupon code and an instructor coupon code?

Udemy coupon codes come from regular promotions run on the Udemy platform. These are automatically applied to qualifying courses or subscriptions. If you are subscribed to marketing emails from Udemy, you will receive email notifications on when these promotions are happening.

Instructor coupon codes are generated by the instructors themselves. They usually share these codes using various channels such as promotional announcements or via their personal social media accounts.

Please note that these two types of coupon codes, set individually by either Udemy or the instructor, may not always offer the same discount or be valid for the same time period. To determine if you are using an Udemy or instructor coupon code, please check within the course landing page.

You can also review the label on the coupon code during checkout.

If there’s no visible discount or coupon code, that means the course is being offered at its standard price.

How do I use a coupon code on Udemy?

You can redeem Udemy coupon codes during checkout.

If you’re using Udemy coupon codes from a Udemy sale or promotion, they will auto-apply to eligible courses and subscriptions at checkout.

If you have an instructor coupon code, you can enter it into the coupon code field and click Apply (Learn how). If the instructor provided you with a direct link containing the coupon code, clicking on it will automatically apply the code to your cart. Remember to review the checkout page before clicking checkout to make sure you have applied all your coupon codes.

Please note:

  • Currently, coupon codes are not supported on our mobile app.
  • Not all instructors have opted into Udemy promotions. So, some courses or subscriptions may not be eligible for a coupon code if they are not part of the ongoing Udemy sale.
  • Gift codes can also be redeemed in the same way as a coupon (Learn more).

Why is my Udemy coupon code not showing?

There could be several reasons as to why your Udemy coupon code may not be showing in the cart:

  • If you are having problems with your shopping cart, please view our troubleshooting steps for website issues.
  • Coupon codes are currently not supported on our mobile app. If you are using the Udemy mobile app, please log into Udemy.com on a browser. (Learn how)
  • For Udemy coupon codes that are part of a limited time promotion, please check to make sure the promotion has not ended.
  • Udemy promotions can vary in length and scope, and not all sales apply to our entire marketplace. Not all instructors have opted into Udemy promotions, so some courses may not be eligible for a coupon that is part of an ongoing Udemy sale.

Why did the discount price change for my course or subscription?

Courses: Learn more about course pricing and why you may see a different price for a course.

Subscriptions: Learn more about our pricing for the Personal Plan subscription.

Why do I see “sorry, this course is not included in this promotion” when I try to redeem the coupon code?

Instructors create and manage their own courses on Udemy. As such, they can decide if their courses will be included in Udemy’s promos and sales. If you encounter a notice saying a coupon code cannot be redeemed for a specific course, most likely it is because the instructor chose not to opt-in their course. However, most instructors on Udemy do opt-in to our Udemy’s promo program, so you’ll likely be able to use the coupon code for a similar course that is participating.

  • View our Help Center article on searching for courses on Udemy. Keep in mind that Udemy promotions may not always apply to every course and can vary in length. Every sale is unique!

How long are coupon codes good for?

Udemy coupon codes: If you have a coupon code that’s part of a Udemy promotion, then the coupon code can be used on eligible courses or subscriptions until the promotion ends.

The duration of specific Udemy promotions may vary. Some promotions may run for several days, while others may run for multiple weeks. In addition, the maximum amount of redemptions for coupons can vary, depending on the coupon or the promotion.

Instructor coupon codes: Like Udemy codes, coupons provided by instructors may expire or reach a maximum number of redemptions. Our coupon system allows instructors to generate different types of coupons with varying expiration windows and redemption limits.

We expect our instructors to communicate the specifics of each coupon they distribute, but if you’re unsure about the terms of a coupon code an instructor has provided for you, we advise asking them directly.

Why can’t I enter coupon codes on the Udemy mobile app?

The Udemy mobile app features payment systems for Google Play (Android) and the Apple App Store (iOS), and as a result, there is currently no way to redeem a Udemy coupon on those platforms. Instructions on how to enter coupons or gift codes at Udemy.com are posted above.

I recently purchased a course but now have a coupon code that will discount the course price to lower than what I paid. What can I do?

Learn more about submitting a partial refund request.

Can instructor coupon codes be used on Udemy subscriptions?

As instructor coupon codes are generated for their course promotions, they cannot be used on Udemy subscriptions.

Udemy course pricing: Learner FAQ

This article answers the most frequently asked questions we receive regarding pricing for Udemy courses.

  • View our frequently asked questions about Udemy coupons.

Frequently asked questions

  • Why did the price change for my course?
  • Is my course a one-time purchase?
  • How can I get a Udemy coupon or a discount code?
  • Does Udemy offer subscriptions?
  • How are you calculating exchange rates? Does Udemy charge currency conversion fees?
  • Do I have to pay taxes when I purchase a course?

Why did the price change for my course?

Udemy’s goal is to help match learners to the right course at the right price, and occasionally that may result in different promotions for the same course. For example, promotions may be run that target different regions, markets, or prospective learners. To see the latest Udemy promotion that’s available for your account, please be sure that you’re logged in. In addition, instructors can also run independent promotions for their courses if they wish.

Further, when purchasing courses via our mobile app, depending on your device, location, and what country your Udemy account is registered in, your payment options may include Apple App Store and Google Play.

  • Please note: Udemy does not have control over the price tier structure provided by these platforms. As a result, the course price listed on the mobile apps may differ slightly from the course price posted on Udemy.com. This is because the pricing matrix for these mobile providers will select the price tier that is closest to the course price set by the Udemy instructor, but they do not always match up exactly. Additionally, courses on the mobile app may have a different price listed during a sale, because there is no way to enter coupon codes on the Udemy mobile app like there is on the web version of Udemy.com.

If you encounter a price discrepancy on the mobile app, and have a coupon code to discount a course, please enter the code on our web version at www.udemy.com. Once you have purchased the course at Udemy.com you will also be able to access it on the mobile app.

Is my course a one-time payment?

Once you have completed a purchase for an individual, marketplace course, you can learn at your own pace and you will not be charged for the course again. You will have lifetime access to the course material as long as you continue to have access to your Udemy account, and Udemy continues to have a license to that course.

How can I get a Udemy coupon or a discount code?

Learn more about Udemy coupon codes.

Does Udemy offer subscriptions?

Yes. In addition to purchasing individual, marketplace courses, eligible learners can also enroll in our Personal Plan subscription offerings. Learners enrolled in a subscription will have unlimited access to the subscription’s content, as long as they are paying the subscription fee.

  • Learn more about Udemy’s Personal Plan.
  • Learn how to sign up for a Udemy subscription.

How are you calculating exchange rates? Does Udemy charge currency conversion fees?

We are using a country-specific price tier matrix to determine a learner’s localized price. The matrix will be updated periodically based on market conditions.

Udemy does not charge currency conversion fees when you purchase a course. However, your financial institution or the third-party payment processor may apply a currency conversion rate or fee (Learn more).

Do I have to pay taxes when I purchase a course?

Learners who reside in regions that collect transaction taxes like VAT, GST, or other types of sales taxes, may be required to pay a tax when they make a purchase on the Udemy platform. Taxes are calculated based on a variety of factors such as account and billing information.

  • Learn which taxes may be charged for course purchases.

Udemy credits: Frequently asked questions

Frequently asked questions

About Credits

  • What are Udemy credits?

  • How do I use Udemy credits?

  • Can I get my money back from Udemy credits?

  • When do credits expire?

  • Can credits be put on hold?

  • Can I gift Udemy credits?

  • Will credits be applied to a gift purchase? Promotional code credits

  • I received an additional promotional amount with my gift code

  • How do I redeem my Udemy credits from a promotional code?

  • What if I lose my gift or promotional code for Udemy credits?

About Credits

What are Udemy credits?

Udemy credits are a balance that can be used towards purchasing any Udemy course. They will be automatically applied to your next course purchase at Udemy.com.

For example, if you’ve had $10 of USD credits added to your account and the next course you purchase is listed at $30 USD, you will only be charged $20 USD.

How do I use Udemy credits?

Udemy credits in your account are automatically applied to your course purchase. When proceed to the payment page, you will see the total credits applied to the purchase, as well as any remaining credits.

Please note: Udemy credits cannot be used on the Udemy mobile app. They can only be applied to purchases on Udemy.com.

Can I get my money back from Udemy credits?

Udemy Credits are not able to be exchanged or reversed to a different payment method.

When do credits expire?

You can view your Expiry date on your credit history page.

Please note: If you don’t use your Udemy Credit within the period of time set by your state, country, or other governing body’s unclaimed property laws (typically around 3-5 years, although these periods vary), we may process any amounts due to you in accordance with our legal obligations. This may include attempting to notify you of any unused credits and reporting and escheating (in other words, sending) those amounts to the appropriate governing body as required by applicable laws.

Can credits be put on hold?

No. Udemy.com is set up to automatically apply Udemy credits to your next course purchase, regardless of the expiration date, until all your account credits have been used.

Can credits be applied to the Udemy mobile app?

Udemy credits cannot be applied to purchases on the Udemy iOS mobile app.

Depending on your location, some course purchases on the Udemy Android app will be processed by Udemy.com’s checkout. In this case, you may be eligible to use Udemy credits if your checkout is redirected to Udemy.com. However, in-app purchases through the Android app are ineligible for credits to be applied through the Google Play payment system.

How can I check my account’s credits?

After logging in to your Udemy account, you can check your account’s credit information by navigating to your Udemy credits page.

You can also access the page by scrolling to your profile icon and clicking Udemy credits.

Can I purchase a Personal Plan subscription using credits?

At this time, credits can only be used for course purchases. They are not able to be used when purchasing a Personal Plan subscription.

Can I gift Udemy credits?

While Udemy credits are not able to be transferred, you can use your Udemy credits to send a gift to friends, family, and colleagues.

  • View our frequently asked questions on sending gifts.
Will credits be applied to a gift purchase?

Yes. Udemy credits in your account will also be automatically applied to a course you purchase as a gift.

Please note: Udemy credits are not transferable to other accounts through refunds. If a gift purchased with credits is refunded, the credits will be returned to the original sender’s account.

Promotional code credits

I received an additional promotional amount with my gift code

Udemy or our partners may run certain campaigns, during which you may receive a promotional amount with the purchase of a gift code in a single code. The gift code amount is equal to the amount paid to purchase the code. The promotional amount is the additional unpaid value that you may receive in Udemy Credits on top of the gift code amount, as detailed in the campaign.

When you redeem the single code, the gift code amount will be applied to your account. The expiration date of the promotional amount can be found on the code’s redemption page or the Udemy credits page.

How do I redeem my Udemy credits from a promotional code?

If you have received an email for a gift or a promotional code, click on the redemption link in the email to redeem your credits. Once you have redeemed the code, the credits will be added to your account.

Can I request a cash refund for a gift or promotional code before it’s redeemed for Udemy credits?

If you have purchased a gift or promotional code from a third-party vendor, you will need to contact that vendor directly, for information regarding the company’s refund policies.

What if I lose my gift or promotional code for Udemy credits?

If you lose your gift or promotional code, please contact the retailer where the code was purchased. Since the initial transaction did not occur on the Udemy platform, we do not have access to the necessary information and cannot offer additional assistance.

Can I redeem more than one promotional code for credits?

Generally speaking, promotional code campaigns are limited to one code per person. Additionally, if you qualify to receive more than one promotional code as part of separate campaigns, only one promotional code can be redeemed for credits, until you have applied that first set of credits towards a course purchase (or until the first set of promotional credits expire).

Where can I access a copy of my receipt, invoice or credit note?

Understanding international transaction fees and currency conversion in certain countries

At Udemy, we understand that transparency in billing is important and that unexpected charges can be frustrating. This article explains international transaction and currency conversion charges, and why they may occur when purchasing courses on Udemy.

  • Review answers for the more frequently asked questions we receive regarding currencies, and how currencies are assigned to Udemy accounts.

Why you may see additional charges

Purchases made on Udemy are done so via one of our supported currencies. For example, our Brazilian customers will see prices in Brazilian reais (BRL), or Peruvian Sol for our customers in Peru. While Udemy charges customers in their designated currency, there are instances where you might see an additional charges on your credit card statement. Here’s why:

Currency conversion: Some transactions on Udemy are processed through our designated payment processors, which may use currencies like USD or EUR. This can lead to currency conversion if your credit card company processes transactions in a different currency. Your credit card company may charge a foreign exchange fee in such cases.

Cross-border transactions: Another scenario where additional charges can occur is when your credit card and Udemy are registered in different countries. Even if the currency used in the transaction matches your local currency, your credit card company might apply an international transaction fee.

If you notice these aforementioned transactions in your banking information and have additional questions about them and why they were applied, please reach out to your financial institution for more information.

How to minimize additional charges

While some additional charges may be out of our control, you can take steps to minimize them.

Consider using a credit card that allows you to hold multiple currencies. Such cards often offer better exchange rates and lower conversion fees. We recommend contacting your financial institution if you have more questions regarding how to minimize these charges.

Still have questions?

If you still have questions about billing or additional charges, please contact your financial institution or Udemy Support.

Quality Review Process

Calculating Course Length

In order to be approved for the Udemy marketplace, courses must have a minimum of five lectures and at least thirty minutes of video content (note: no video content is needed for “Practice Test Only” courses). When you upload your video lectures for a course and add it to the course curriculum, the system will automatically calculate the time of the video content.

Please note:

  • In order for the system to detect and calculate the time of your videos, the lectures must be published. Learn how to create and publish lectures.
  • Free courses can only be a maximum of 2 hours in video length. Where the course length can be viewed

The length of your course is advertised on the course landing page in two different locations.

The approximate time for on-demand videos is posted in the Buy Now or Enroll Now section at the top right hand of the course landing page:

The entire course length, including non-video lectures, is posted in the Course content section farther down the course landing page.

How course time is calculated per lecture type

The length of a course (as shown in the Course content section of the course landing page) is calculated using the criteria below:

Curriculum Item

Time

Article Lectures

One minute for every 240 words

Video Lectures

The duration of the video

Video & Mashup Lectures

The duration of the video included in the mashup

Assignments

If a video is included in the instruction section of the assignment, then the duration of the video will be added to the course time

Please note: since the time a student may take to complete practice tests, quizzes, or coding exercises may vary, these curriculum items do not count towards the course length.

Udemy’s Quality Review Process

This article outlines Udemy’s Quality Review Process, which every course must pass in order to be published and discoverable in the Udemy marketplace.

Table of contents

  • What is the Quality Review Process?
  • What you need to know
  • Course review time
  • Check course feedback
  • Approved
  • Needs fixes
  • Questions About Your Review
  • Re-submit for Review

What is the Quality Review Process?

At Udemy, our mission is to help anyone learn anything online. To ensure that students have great learning experiences, we have a Quality Review Process in place that every course goes through.

Once your course is completely ready, you need to submit your course for review to enter the course into Udemy’s Quality Review Process.

  • Learn more about submitting your course for review. After you submit your course for review, Udemy’s Quality Review Team will evaluate your course and provide feedback on all the items in our Course Quality Checklist. Once your course passes, it will be published for anyone to discover in the Udemy marketplace. Until then, your course will not be discoverable in the marketplace.

What you need to know

  • All courses will be reviewed based on the Course Quality Checklist.
  • Required items on the list are required to pass the Quality Review Process.
  • Recommended items on the list are highly recommended, as our research has shown these factors to significantly impact student satisfaction. While they are not required to pass the Quality Review Process, they are typically the factors that distinguish the great courses from the rest.
  • Your course must pass the Quality Review Process to be published in the Udemy marketplace.
  • You can submit your course for review by clicking “Submit for Review” at the bottom of your course page. Learn more about submitting your course for review.
  • The Quality Review Process takes 2 business days.

Course review time

The Quality Review Team will review your course based on our Course Quality Checklist. After your course is added to the Quality Review Team queue, you should receive a reply within 2 business days. In some cases, reviews may take longer due to high submission volume or additional verification or policy checks. If your course requires fixes and is resubmitted, additional review time may be required.

To check the status of your course, go to the Instructor Dashboard. A label will appear showing if your course is Live, In Review, Submitted for Review, or Needs Fixes. If your course remains in the same status for several business days after resubmission, you can contact support for assistance.

Check course feedback

The Quality Review Team will give feedback on the course feedback page, and they will inform you whether the course has been approved, or if it requires fixes.

Approved

If the Quality Review Team does not identify any required fixes, your course will be live and published in the marketplace.

Please note: After a course has been approved and published in the marketplace, it may take up to 24 hours for the course to be discoverable in search results.

Please review any recommendations the team has provided on how to improve student course satisfaction. Action on this type of feedback, however, is not required.

Needs fixes

If your course requires fixes, then it is not live on the Udemy marketplace, regardless of whether it is public or private. To publish the course, please make any required changes, mark them as fixed, and resubmit the course for review.

Please ensure all required feedback has been fully addressed before resubmitting, as additional issues may be identified during subsequent reviews.

This article shows how you can view the review team’s feedback, and how you can mark required changes as fixed or respond to the review team directly.

You will receive an email when your course is done being reviewed, which will include a link to your course dashboard, where you can see feedback. If you do not receive an update after several business days, please check your course status in the dashboard before contacting support.

Questions About Your Review

If you have questions about the feedback you’ve received, speak to a reviewer directly from the feedback page and hit reply. Once you hit reply, our team will be notified of your question and will respond back as soon as possible.

To see an example of how to do this, please refer to this article.

If instructor identity verification or other required checks are still in progress, your course review may take longer than expected.

Re-submit for Review

Click mark as fixed as you complete all required fixes. When you’re ready for Udemy to review your course again, click the resubmit for review at the bottom of the page.

Once your course is approved, your course link will go live, and students can discover and enroll in your course.

Viewing Course Feedback

A few days after submitting your course for review, the Udemy review team will leave you course feedback. The course feedback page will list needed and recommended fixes. Before your course can be approved for the marketplace, you will need to complete all the required fixes.

Reviewing Feedback

If the course requires edits, then Needs Fixes will appear on the course image that is posted on your Courses page.

You can access the feedback page by moving your cursor to the applicable course and by clicking See Feedback. You can also access the feedback by navigating to the course management page and by clicking on Course feedback on the left-hand side (if the course is published it will say Udemy feedback).

Communicating With the Review Team

If you have any questions about your feedback, you can reply to comments directly. The reviewer will get back to you, usually within a day. In order for the review team to see your feedback and or question, however, you will need to mark each request as fixed and then resubmit the course for review.

Marking Items as Fixed

Once you’ve made the required changes, you must mark each item as fixed in order to resubmit your course for review.

To mark a request as fixed, click on Mark as Fixed on the right hand side. If you need to undo this, click on Unmark as Fixed and the entry section will reappear.

Once each request is marked as fixed then the Resubmit for Review icon at the bottom right of the page will turn color. You can resend your course to the review team by clicking on the icon.

Partial refund requests

Submitting a partial refund request

How can I submit a refund request?

Learn how to submit a refund request. More information regarding refunds is also available in our Refund Policy.

Where can I see the status of my refund?

You can see the status of your refund in the Refunds section of your Purchase History page. In the Refund Status column you can see the date your refund request was submitted or when it was processed.

The amount of your refund and the payment type it was refunded to is also included.

When will I receive my refund?

Refund requests are submitted immediately to your payment processor or financial institution after Udemy has received and processed your request. It may take 5 to 10 business days or longer to post the funds in your account, depending on your financial institution or location.

If you requested a refund within 24 hours of purchasing the course, however, it may be processed as a purchase reversal (please see below for more information).

Can I cancel my refund request after I’ve submitted it?

No. As noted above, refund requests are submitted immediately to your payment processor or financial institution after Udemy has received and processed your request. As a result, there is no way to cancel a refund request after it’s been submitted.

You can, however, re-purchase and re-enroll in a Udemy marketplace course if you have changed your mind or submitted the refund request by mistake. Please note that any course progress you made in the refunded course will not be restored if you re-purchase it.

I requested a refund more than 10 business days ago, but I still do not see it in my bank account. Where is my refund?

As noted above, it may take 5 to 10 business days to post the funds in your account after Udemy has processed your refund request, depending on your financial institution or location. Some refunds, however, may not post to your account for up to 30 days. If it has been more than 10 business days since the refund was processed by Udemy, please contact your bank directly to inquire about the status of the refund. If the bank does not see the refund in their records, please contact Udemy Support by clicking Contact Us.

It has been more than 30 days since I requested my refund but I haven’t received it yet. What do I do now?

If it has been more than 30 days since you requested a refund, and you still haven’t received it, then please contact Udemy Support.

What is the difference between a refund and a purchase reversal?

If you paid with a credit or debit card, most refunds that are processed within 24 hours of the purchase are processed as reversals. What this means is that the original charge will be removed from your bank or credit card statement, usually within 5 business days. If it is a reversal, then you will not see the refunds credited back to your account, since they were never withdrawn.

Why was my refund request denied?

All eligible courses purchased on Udemy can be refunded within 30 days, provided the request meets the guidelines in our refund policy. Certain restrictions may apply and some purchases may only be eligible for credit refunds. Learn more about our refund policy.

What is a “credit refund”?

In cases where a transaction is not eligible for a refund to your original payment method, the refund will be granted using Udemy Credits, provided it meets our refund policy. You can learn more about which types of transactions are only eligible for credit refunds in our Refund Policy.

Alternatively, if your transaction is eligible for a refund to your original payment method, you can choose to receive Udemy Credits as your refund method instead. The credits will be added to your account, immediately after your refund is processed, so that you can use them towards your next purchase. You can check your credit balance by navigating to your Udemy credits page.

To learn more about Udemy Credits and how they work, please review our Udemy Credits FAQ.

Our 30-day policy

While our 30-day refund policy is to allow students to learn risk free, we must also protect our instructors from fraud and provide them a reasonable payment schedule. Payments are sent to instructors after 30 days, so we will not process refund requests received after the refund window.

Additional reasons for denied refunds

We reserve the right, in our sole discretion, to limit or deny refund requests in cases where we believe there is refund abuse, including but not limited to the following:

  • A notable amount of the course has been consumed or downloaded by a student before the refund was requested.
  • Multiple refunds have been requested by a student for the same course.
  • Excessive refunds have been requested by a student.
  • Users who have their account reported, banned or course access disabled due to a violation of our Terms or Trust & Safety Guidelines.
  • A refund has already been granted by a third party, such as one of Udemy’s third-party payment processors.
  • We do not grant refunds for any subscriptions and coaching services unless otherwise required by applicable law (please see below for more information). These refund restrictions will be enforced to the extent permitted by applicable law.

Credit refunds

In cases where a transaction is not eligible for a cash refund, we exercise our discretion to not provide a cash refund, or if you select to receive your refund in the form of Udemy credits, the refund will be granted in the form of Udemy credits, provided it otherwise meets our 30-day refund policy. These credits are issued by and are solely an obligation of Udemy LEARN Services, LLC, an affiliate of Udemy, Inc., and are subject to the Terms.

If your course purchase is only eligible for a credit refund, this will be indicated on the refund page.

The Review System

Instructor guidelines on using student reviews

Instructors may use course reviews published on Udemy to market their courses, however, this type of usage is subject to the following guidelines:

  • Reviews should be from Udemy students, and posted currently on your Udemy course.
  • Instructors are not permitted to use full student names or other information which might identify them, such as their job title. Reviews must be at least partially anonymized, by either listing the student’s first name and last initial only, or removing the student’s name entirely.
  • Follow journalistic practices when quoting course reviews. For example, ellipses can be used to shorten reviews, but they shouldn’t otherwise be modified.
  • If a student complains about an instructor’s use of their course review, the instructor must follow best practices in quickly removing the review from their marketing materials, course content, social media, etc.
  • As always, instructors are responsible for ensuring that they comply with applicable laws, including marketing laws.

Rules against manipulating or influencing the review system

It can be challenging to gather meaningful feedback on new courses, especially as a new instructor. You are welcome to ask for feedback, but be mindful of how you engage your students.

Rules when asking for reviews

  • Instructors cannot indicate what type of rating or review a student should leave, or outline any detail or information to be included
  • Instructors may not specify what medium should be used to express varying feedback
  • Instructors are not permitted to trade reviews with other instructors
  • Instructors must decline any offer from a student to provide a positive review in exchange for goods or services, and should report the request
  • Instructors must not seek to systematically reward positive reviews

How to ask for reviews

  • Please give me feedback on my course by writing a review!
  • I really hope you found this course valuable, but either way, please leave a review and share your experience.
  • Tell me what you think! Write a review when you can. I’m also available for questions - send me a direct message anytime.

How NOT to ask for reviews

  • If you liked the course, please give me a 5-star review!
  • If you did NOT like the course, please send me a direct message instead of leaving a review.
  • I worked very hard on this course and I hope you found it valuable and will leave a positive review about your experience.
  • If you leave a (5-star) review, I’ll give you my next course free!

Major violations

The following activities are considered egregious breaches of trust with Udemy students, and may result in the permanent removal of the offending course and the instructor from the Udemy marketplace.

  • Purchased Reviews (reviews in exchange for money)
  • Incentivized Reviews including offer of free or discounted courses
  • Multiple reviews from a single source (e.g. one user w/ multiple enrollments)
  • Reviews generated by bots, scripts, or other inorganic means When an instructor is clearly going against the spirit of Udemy policies in an attempt to game the system, or if we see a severe negative impact on the student experience, it will be considered a violation of our policies.

Udemy review system guidelines

The primary purpose of student reviews on Udemy is to help prospective students evaluate if a course is a match for their learning goals. Our review system empowers students to find and enroll in the courses that are most likely to fit their needs. Written reviews also provide instructors with direct feedback which can help them improve their content.

In order for the review system to be effective, students must trust that the system is fair and that Udemy is a neutral party. Instructors can flag reviews, but Udemy will only remove them if they meet the specific, objective criteria outlined below.

Udemy removes reviews in several scenarios:

  1. Reviews removed by the Automatic (Spam) Review Filter: If a review, along with the behavior of the reviewer, scores high in our algorithm as potentially spam, the review will not appear. Udemy scans all student ratings and reviews to identify those that are likely to be inauthentic. We incorporate many data points to ensure course feedback reflects the engaged, unbiased opinions of learners with a genuine interest in the course material.

Occasionally, reviews left by friends and family have been hidden by this filter. If you believe that a review has been removed incorrectly, you can let us know at policy@udemy.com. While we are unable to provide any details about the filter, we will investigate to confirm that everything is working as intended.

  1. Negative reviews reported as policy abuse: Anyone on Udemy can report a review as an abuse of Udemy’s policy, at which point our policy team will examine whether the review meets one of the criteria that warrants removal. Learn more about when a negative review is against policy.

  2. Reviews acquired improperly: Instructors are expected to follow Udemy’s rules against manipulating or influencing reviews, as well as the spirit of the review system as a tool for students to help each other evaluate courses. Learn more about Udemy’s rules against manipulating or influencing reviews.

When is a negative review against Udemy policy?

Occasionally, students may express themselves in a way that undermines the integrity of the review system. If a review is flagged, it will only be removed if it clearly falls into one the following categories.

Reviews unrelated to the student’s learning experience with the instructor

Examples of reviews Udemy will NOT remove:

  • The instructor is constantly trying to sell stuff to me

  • The instructor was rude to me in the FB group they moderate

  • I don’t believe the instructor’s credentials/that this instructor is qualified to teach this topic Examples of reviews Udemy WILL remove:

  • I divorced this instructor for good reason

  • I had a bad business deal with this instructor (unrelated/prior to enrollment)

  • I took a different course on this topic that I recommend very highly

  • The instructor is so ugly, I can’t stand looking at them

  • You’re asking me for a review too early

Reviews focusing on technical issues outside the instructor’s control

Examples of reviews Udemy will NOT remove:

  • I can’t use the downloadable resources

  • The audio is so distorted I can’t hear the instructor

  • This course is not made to be watchable on mobile

  • Some of the lectures don’t play (reproducible problem with original file)

  • The instructor didn’t say I needed to buy additional software to take this course. Examples of reviews Udemy WILL remove:

  • The video playback is choppy (due to Udemy/internet speeds)

  • The software the instructor used is expensive, you should use this (free) software

  • The captions are poor quality

Reviews deemed obscene, profane, threatening, or hate speech

Examples of reviews Udemy will NOT remove:

  • I can’t understand this instructor’s accent

  • I can’t stand listening to this instructor; they are so annoying

  • This course is worse than going to the dentist Examples of reviews Udemy WILL remove:

  • I can never understand courses from people of this background

  • This course is f**king bullsh*t

  • I’d rather gouge my eyes out than watch this course

  • This instructor should just go and die

Reviews from parties with a demonstrated conflict of interest

Examples of reviewers Udemy does NOT consider in conflict:

  • A Udemy instructor with a course in a different subject

  • A competitor/colleague who does not teach online

  • A student with previous experience with the instructor Examples of reviewers Udemy does consider in conflict:

  • An instructor with a competing course

  • A recorded personal or professional relationship unrelated to learning or teaching

  • A recorded history of harassment or abuse elsewhere online

Accessing Your Student List

How to access your student list for a specific course

You can access the student list for a specific course by following these steps:

  1. Navigate to the course management page (Learn more).

  2. Click Students on the left-hand side.

Student list information

On the Students page, you can monitor your learner’s course progress with the following information

Name: The user name the learner has selected for their Udemy account.

Enrolled: The date the learner enrolled in your course.

Progress: The percentage of total published lectures in your course that the learner has completed, or marked as complete.

Last Visited: The last date the learner accessed and consumed content from the course. This will help you determine whether a learner has recently been active in your course recently.

Questions Asked: This total indicates how many questions a learner has asked in the Q&A, which helps demonstrate which learner may require more assistance.

Questions Answered: The number of questions a learner has answered in the Q&A helps identify learners who are highly engaged in the course.

Message: Click this icon to be directed to the Messages page, where you can write a new direct message for that learner. The messaging tool will automatically add the learner’s name as the recipient.

  • Learn more about our rules and guidelines for messaging students. See below for additional columns only available when using the Export as CSV feature.

Export as a CSV

Additional columns are available only when exporting the data as a CSV. Click the Export as CSV button to automatically receive an email with a CSV file

The following columns are available only in CSV file format:

Started Date: The date that learners began viewing the course material

  • Please note: This information may differ from the enrollment date. Lecture Last Viewed: The video lecture that the learner last visited in the course.

  • This provides context about what a learner last reviewed in your course and can help you engage with them more effectively. Udemy Business: A column in the CSV titled Udemy Business will indicate whether the learner enrolled via the Udemy Business content subscription program

  • This information is also visible in the Student List web view as a “Udemy Business” tag next to the Student Name Learn more about the Performance Students tab.

Why is a user name on my revenue report but not on the student list?

When a learner receives your course as a Udemy gift, their username will be added to your student list, after they redeem the gift code and enroll in your course. The username of the gift purchaser, however, is listed in the purchase tab of your Revenue Report and is not included on the student list (unless they purchased the course for themselves previously).
